The Fire Chief shall be appointed by the City Commission and employed under such terms and conditions as the City Commission may deem appropriate. The Fire Chief shall receive such compensation as the City Commission may by resolution fix and designate.

(b) The individual serving as Fire Chief on the effective date of this section shall automatically become the first appointed Fire Chief.

(c) The Fire Chief shall reside in the City of Fort Lauderdale during his or her employment with the city, but he or she need not be a resident of the City of Fort Lauderdale or the State of Florida at the time of his or her appointment.
